verdict.rationale: Mercury documents earning yield on balances, with "up to 3.89% yield with Treasury by Mercury Advisory" plus savings accounts, and supports internal transfers into treasury accounts. Nothing in the pack shows balances held in currencies other than USD, let alone interest earned on them; the only currency reference is to USD payments. Missing for 10: any evidence of multi-currency balances, interest or yield on non-USD holdings, rate and terms detail per currency, and independent corroboration.
